cards.title: Add your baby to health insurance
cards.body: You are likely eligible to add your baby to your health insurance outside the usual sign-up period, but only for a short time. Do this by 2026-11-09.

sources.label: Add your baby to health insurance

cards.body: No money to claw back yet. Connect a card or upload Amazon orders.

cards.body: Connect your data to safety-check your items.

cards.title: Start or change your Dependent Care FSA
cards.body: Your employer offers a Dependent Care FSA (a work account for daycare costs), and you are likely eligible to start or change it because of your new baby. Do this by 2026-11-09.

sources.label: Start or change your Dependent Care FSA

cards.title: Federal Child Tax Credit
cards.body: You are likely eligible for the federal Child Tax Credit, worth up to $2,200.00. You claim it on your yearly tax return.

cards.title: Massachusetts Child and Family Tax Credit
cards.body: As a Massachusetts resident, you are likely eligible for the state Child and Family Tax Credit of $440.00, claimed on your state tax return.

sources.label: Massachusetts Child and Family Tax Credit

cards.title: Massachusetts Paid Family and Medical Leave
cards.body: You are likely eligible for Massachusetts Paid Family and Medical Leave, which may pay you while you are off work with your baby. Do this by 2027-10-10.

sources.label: Massachusetts Paid Family and Medical Leave

cards.title: Trump Account: $1,000 federal starter deposit
cards.body: Your baby is likely eligible for a federal starter deposit of $1,000.00 in a Trump Account (a savings account opened for your baby).
